author: aobolensk
title: CPU functional tests artifact upload fails with ENOTFOUND on Windows runner
signature: Failed to CreateArtifact Unable to make request ENOTFOUND|Network

failed_jobs.name: CPU functional tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Artifact upload step fails with ENOTFOUND (DNS resolution failure) after all 160,863 tests passed

key_errors:
2026-08-31T21:45:25.7717558Z ##[error]Failed to CreateArtifact: Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND
If you are using self-hosted runners, please make sure your runner has access to all GitHub endpoints: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/hosting-your-own-runners/managing-self-hosted-runners/about-self
root_cause: The self-hosted Windows runner temporarily lost DNS resolution for the GitHub artifact storage endpoint during the upload step. The actual test execution completed successfully (160,863 passed, 16,524 skipped) — no test failures. The ENOTFOUND error indicates a transient DNS/network outage on the runner host at the time of artifact upload.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure not reproducible locally
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job - the network issue is transient and tests pass fine
If the runner repeatedly exhibits DNS failures, investigate the runner host network configuration
prevention_strategies: No code change needed. Monitor runner network stability. Consider adding retry logic to artifact uploads in the workflow.
historical_context: First recorded occurrence of this specific ENOTFOUND artifact upload failure signature.
